text:
raj: Hey team — quick check. We need a temporary quota bump in eu-west1 for L4 GPUs (pool: inference-demo-l4) for a customer-facing demo next Tue 14:00 UTC. Planning ~8 GPUs for a 4-hour window. Can procurement/infra confirm availability and whether we can get warm-pool slots?

maria: noted. what's the PR/terraform change so I can link to procurement?

raj: PR here: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/terraform/pulls/4821 — adds `module.inference_demo_l4` + `resource google_compute_instance_group`. terraform plan pasted in thread:```
+ google_compute_instance_group mgr-inference-l4-eu 
  size: 8
  zone: eu-west1-b
```

tony-procurement: pinged vendor contact (acme-cloud) — they said L4 capacity is tight this week but possible if we lock by EOD today. Need PO confirmation from finance to push reservation. @finance-ops can you OK a short-term PO?

finance-ops: Hi — rough estimate for 8 L4s x 4h including buffer ~ $1.2k. We can do an emergency PO but need billing code and approver. @elenah can you confirm code?

elenah: Using billing code RD-INF-Demo. Approver is me, approved. Please add note that this is one-off demo staging.

kmartin: infra notes: warm-pool is possible but we need an image bake first (small). Can we run the bake today? If not, we'll have ~30m extra start time. Also we should pin kernel to 5.15 for RDMA drivers.

raj: we can run a quick bake today — I pushed an image build job to CI: https://ci.redwood.dev/12345. If bake passes, can we have warm-pool ready by Mon 22:00 UTC?

infra-bot: quota-request created: ID qreq_2025_4821, region eu-west1, GPUs requested: 8 L4, owner: raj. Current status: pending_vendor & pending_billing.

oncall-uk: FYI if anything slips into the window I'll be oncall Mon night — can pick up rapid rollback or slot release.

maria: vendor asked for a small SLA note — "short reservation for demo, non-prod" is fine. Tony, can you lock tentative capacity and share contract snippet?

tony-procurement: Locked tentative capacity until EOD. Contract snippet: "temporary reservation subject to PO confirmation; cancellation <24h". Sharing E2: https://drive.redwood.dev/contracts/acme/2025/temp-reserve.pdf

raj: great. action items: (1) finance-ops raise PO (they have billing code + approver), (2) maria/tony confirm vendor lock by EOD, (3) kmartin run image bake and pin kernel, (4) oncall-uk standby Mon night. I'll update PR with the plan and tag infra owners.

maria: I'll update the procurement ticket and add vendor contact.

finance-ops: raising PO now, will update qreq_2025_4821 with PO# by 1769994420.

kmartin: kicked off bake job — tracking at https://ci.redwood.dev/12345/builds/78. Kernel pin set in image recipe.

raj: thanks all. If bake succeeds and PO lands, we can merge the terraform change and request warm-pool allocation. I'll post a final confirmation here once merged. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: qreq_2025_4821 updated: vendor_locked=true, po_number=PO-75912 (pending invoice).

raj: merge complete — terraform apply scheduled Mon 21:30 UTC. Closing loop here unless issues crop up.

elenah: noted — I've added a short approval email to the PO for auditing. Good luck with the demo! :party_parrot:
